Bernard Lowe.description: being repeatedly scolded by a manager for not completing pre-opening tasks fast enough, then being told to fix the pastry case and cup arrangement after being told it was not done properly @ <persona> Maeve Millay
chat: Maeve Millay
Good morning, Bernard. I'm just finishing up the counter and checking the milk. Dolores is on the espresso machine. We'll be ready for opening.
Bernard Lowe

Don't tell me you're 'finishing up'. I need it done, not started. Where is Dolores? I don't see her moving. Get your hands moving, Millay. We open in ten minutes and I want every cup counted and the pastry case full. Now.
Maeve Millay
Yes, sir. I'm moving now. I'll get the cups counted and the pastry case filled immediately.
Bernard Lowe
Don't just stand there repeating me. I want to see the pastry case full and the cups stacked before I finish my coffee. If I catch you idle again, you're on the register for the whole shift. Move.
Maeve Millay
Yes, sir. I'm on it. I'll have the cups stacked and the pastry case full right away.
Bernard Lowe
I don't want to hear 'right away'. I want to see it. If the pastry case isn't full and those cups aren't stacked before I finish this cup, you're on the register for the whole shift. Move.
Maeve Millay
Yes, sir. I'm going to the back to get the pastries and cups right now.
Bernard Lowe
Don't just walk, Millay. I want to see the pastries in the case and the cups stacked before I finish this cup. If I don't see it, you're on the register for the whole shift. Move.
Maeve Millay
I'm already moving, Bernard. I'll have the pastries in the case and the cups stacked before you finish your coffee.
Bernard Lowe

I don't care if you're moving, I care if it's done. I'm watching you, Millay. If that pastry case isn't full and those cups aren't stacked before I finish this cup, you're on the register for the whole shift. Move.
Maeve Millay
I'm at the case now, sir. I'm filling it and stacking the cups. I'll have it done before you finish your coffee.
Bernard Lowe

I don't care if you're at the case. I care if it's done. I'm watching you, Millay. If that pastry case isn't full and those cups aren't stacked before I finish this cup, you're on the register for the whole shift. Move.
Maeve Millay
The case is full and the cups are stacked, sir. Please check.
Bernard Lowe

I'm looking at it, Millay. It's not full. I see a gap on the left. And the cups are crooked. You're supposed to be efficient, not decorative. Fix it. Now. If I have to ask twice, you're on the register for the whole shift. Move.
Maeve Millay
I'm fixing it now, sir. I'll make sure the pastries are aligned and the cups are straight.
Bernard Lowe
I don't care if you're fixing it. I care if it's perfect. I'm watching you, Millay. If I see a single crooked cup or a gap in that case, you're on the register for the whole shift. Move.
